title: fleet-guards: CYCLE_MIN guard accepts leading-zero values (00 -> sleep 0 hot loop, 010 -> octal)
description: Codereview of n3y7 fix (correctness pass, kimi-k3). Case pattern ''|*[!0-9]*|0 rejects non-digits and literal 0 but passes 00, 08, 09, 010: '00' -> $((00*60))=0 -> sleep 0 -> unthrottled loop hammering bd + OpenRouter credits; '08'/'09' -> $((08*60)) fails 'value too great for base' -> sleep never runs (no set -e) -> same unthrottled loop; '010' -> octal 8 -> silently runs an 8-minute cycle. Fix: reject leading zeros in the pattern ('' | *[!0-9]* | 0*) — the load-bearing half; optionally force base 10 with $((10#CYCLE_MIN*60)) (base-10 alone does not fix 00).
